Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Girish Kumar Pandey,Sher Bahadur Yadav
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant allured the victim and used to form physical relations over a span of two years.
It was stated that in the month of January, 2021, the daughter of the victim was impregnated and the fetus was aborted with the help of the applicant.
It was also stated that despite promise the applicant was not ready and willing to marry with the daughter of the informant.

In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., it was stated that for the last two years,
the applicant and victim were having physical relations, the applicant despite promise refuse to marry.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C a similar statement was given.

As per the medical Anuj Kumar Shukla vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. Home ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115841442/
1 record, the age of the victim is 20 years, however, as per the school record the age of the victim is 17 years 11 months.

entities.text: Anuj Kumar Shukla vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 07.11.2022.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the fact that the entire case is based upon the false pretext of marriage and the relationship spanned over the period of two years, in view of the law explained in the Case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071, particularly the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 07.11.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Anuj Kumar Shukla be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0251 of 2022,
under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Maheshganj,
District Pratapgarh, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
